statement: Write J for the height of one piece under i, and L for its length. Set α = 1/4, β = 3/4, and d∗ = 4/3. Then b = X k≥0 i∗k , b(L) = b ∗ i(L) ∗ b, i(J > r) = r−β+o(1) , Ei[L; J ≤ r] ≤ rd∗−β+o(1) , Ei[Le−J/r ] = rd∗−β+o(1) . The discounted lower reward is retained on pieces with height at most r log2 r and lateral excursion at most r log4 r.
